title: One-Punch Man Season 3 Confirms Release Date for Next Major Update
content: One-Punch Man made a very divisive return for Season 3 of the anime last year, and now it’s set to reveal a major update about the anime’s future later this Fall. One-Punch Man has had a very rough go at things when it comes to its anime adaptation over the last decade.
author: ComicBook

title: WEBTOON Acquires 60% Stake in Game Company RI Games Holdings to Expand Webtoons Into Games
content: WEBTOON Entertainment announced on August 10 it has entered into a definitive agreement to make a strategic investment in RI Games Holdings Inc., a move that will give WEBTOON a 60% stake in the game company upon closing.
author: ANN

title: 6 Years Later, The Promised Neverland Returns for New Shonen Jump Sequel
content: Ten years after it first began with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine and six years after it ended, The Promised Neverland has made a surprise return with a brand new sequel entry.

title: Amasian TV Streams Chiikawa Anime for Free in U.S.
content: ODK Media's North American streaming platform Amasian TV announced on Thursday it is now streaming a selection of 20 episodes of the anime adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga with English subtitles and Japanese audio in the United States.

title: Uma Musume Franchise Announces New Umayuru Full Gate! Short Anime
content: The Uma Musume Pretty Derby franchise announced on Saturday a new short anime titled Umayuru Full Gate! , which will stream on the franchise 's official YouTube channel after the broadcast of PakaLive TV in September. Animation studio AtoriE is producing the short anime.
